headline: FIVE ARRESTED 🚨 Near USAF RAF Base 🛫 in TERROR PROBE 💣
text:
FIVE MEN 🧔‍♂️ have been ARRESTED 🔒 on suspicion of PREPARING 🛠️ a TERRORIST ACT 🎯 and EXPLOSIVE OFFENCES 💥 after THREE SUSPICIOUS 🚨 vehicles 🛻 were reported travelling TOWARDS 🏃‍♂️ the RAF FAIRFORD base 🛫 used by UNITED STATES AIR FORCE 🦅!! Counter-terror police 👮‍♂️ declared a MAJOR INCIDENT 🚨 and EVACUATED DOZENS 🏠 of homes near the Gloucestershire airbase ✈️ at 00:45 BST 🌙 on Sunday with an ARMY EXPLOSIVE ORDNANCE DISPOSAL TEAM 🧨 examining the vehicles 🚐 in a WOODED AREA 🌲 while a 400m cordon 🛑 was slammed down and HAZARDOUS RESPONSE TEAMS 🧪 deployed as part of a MASSIVE EMERGENCY SERVICE RUSH 🏥!! "We had them under VIEW 📡 for a LONG TIME ⏳ and we GOT THEM" 🥊 said PRESIDENT DONALD TRUMP 🧑‍🚀 who dropped that they were "LOOKING TO DO BIG DAMAGE" 💣 to the base that recently hosted US warplanes striking Iran 🇮🇷!!

A LOCAL RESIDENT 👩‍🦰 who stayed ANONYMOUS 🙊 told the BBC 📺 she spotted THREE PARKED VANS 🛻 and a group of MASKED MEN 😷 near the base so she first called MoD POLICE 📞 but nobody picked up 📵 forcing her to dial 999 🚨 straight away which kicked off the whole COUNTER TERROR PROBE 🕵️!! POLICE REMAINED 🚓 at the scene ALL DAY 🌞 with a remote-controlled ROBOT 🤖 creeping up on those stationary WHITE VANS 🚐 in the woods 🌳 though cops won't confirm if the bot was even deployed 🛠️ yet residents from nearby WHELFORD 🏘️ were told they CANNOT RETURN HOME 🛌 overnight because the incident is still being treated as CONTAINED 🛡️ by temporary Chief Constable MAGGIE BLYTH 👮‍♀️ who said at the news conference 🗣️ she believes the matter is fully wrapped up with no other suspects being hunted 🧐!!

PRIME MINISTER ANDY BURNHAM 🧔 was kept UPDATED 📲 on the "DEEPLY CONCERNING" 😟 situation while UK DEFENCE SECRETARY WES STREETING 📞 got on the horn with his US counterpart PETE HEGSETH 🇺🇸 and a USAF SPOKESPERSON 🗣️ confirmed personnel are staying VIGILANT 👀 but wouldn't spill any specific FORCE PROTECTION METHODS 🛡️!! Meanwhile the US DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE 🛡️ hiked the threat level at nearby RAF LAKENHEATH 🛫 hosting the 48th Fighter Wing ✈️ all the way up to its SECOND-HIGHEST CATEGORY ⚠️ after an image 📸 purporting to show the five men being ARRESTED 🔗 in Whelford just 350m from runway access at CRASH GATE 6A 🚪 started circulating online even though BBC VERIFY 🔎 geolocated it and called the pic AUTHENTIC 🧾!! The whole operation WAS NOT INTELLIGENCE LED 🧠 according to sources with the men first nicked by GLOUCESTERSHIRE POLICE 🚔 under the EXPLOSIVES ACT 🧨 before being hit with PREPARATION OF A TERRORIST ACT charges 🎯 and they remained in custody 👮‍♂️ through Sunday evening!!

JULIAN TUDSBURY 🧓 said he got RUDELY AWOKEN 😫 at 07:00 by cops BANGING 🥁 on his door in Whelford where 85 households 🏡 were told to EVACUATE 🏃‍♂️ immediately because of a MAJOR INCIDENT 🚨 with another local resident named only JEFF 👨 spotting men being HELD AT GUNPOINT 🔫 outside his house around 02:00 hearing SHOUTING 🗣️ that made the whole thing feel completely SURREAL 😵!! Displaced residents were herded to a LEISURE CENTRE 🏊 for safety while Cotswold District Council 🏛️ promised to find overnight accommodation 🛏️ for anyone who couldn't crash with family or friends after police confirmed the five arrested dudes are still being grilled 🕵️ in this early-stages probe that started when three vehicles 🛻 were seen heading straight for the base used as a STAGING POST ✈️ for American strikes!! The site sits right on the Gloucestershire-Wiltshire border 🌍 sharing a long horny history with the American military that got everyone from the PM down to the MoD sweating bullets 💦 over what those masked lads were actually plotting near Crash Gate 6A!!
